'''''Regdo's Clan Catalog''''' was a document consisting of several bound [[plasticine]] sheets that was compiled by an [[Sentientologist|anthropologist]] and which provided detailed analysis and discussion of the formation and history of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] clan culture. The document was kept within [[Shiin's Library]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
